text: As they give, so they require attention; and, by the way, take this maxim for an undoubted truth, That no young man can possibly improve in any company, for which he has not respect enough to be under some degree of restraint.
author: Philip Stanhope, 4th Earl of Chesterfield
locator: Letter CXCII, to his son, London, December 25, 1753
